body:
The owner asked to assess the ladder handoff and consolidate one main. ADRs 0013, 0014 and 0016 are already on published main at f4ee65b4 and are included in unified candidate 6747bbd3, alongside Film Festival and Own the Metric. Film Festival diagnostics were renumbered to ADR 0017.

The feature pin is committed on solo/ladder-run at 3cc1c949 and integrated. Seven fixed development contrasts are scored and recorded in docs/plans/2026-09-02-recall-to-video-study-log.md: content/hierarchy65.64% versus full65.24%, paired +0.55pp CI[-1.28,+2.55], no arm selected. Full matches all11old monofill-dev reports. The historical shuffle is byte-identical to an unshuffled arm; prior-zero predates decoder/fill, so both are descriptive historical comparisons only.

Full cross-platform integration gate is running. It exposed and we fixed LayerUse.render using Locale.ROOT, which cannot link on Scala.js; decimal scale preserves the pinned four-decimal output and passes all8ledger tests on JVM/JS/Native. Final landing/closure evidence will follow on the bead.
